text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than seven million pupils and students return to schools.
- The government to open dialogue over Algeria's social and economic development.
- Rally for Democracy and Culture (RCD) party boycotts the national conference. Nahda and Republic Alliance parties confirm their participation.
- Spain Foreign Minister Abel Matutes visits Algiers. Spain is interested in the Algerian market potential and hydrocarbon resources.
